job.name: ig28_cover
job.person_note: The SAME woman as in the attached photo: same face, hair colour and features; do not change her face shape.
job.style: A finished, eye-catching vertical Instagram Reels COVER, photorealistic, bright clean daylight tones. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED. No logos, no watermarks, no UI elements.
job.style_qa: обложка: та же женщина, что на референсе, рядом выключенная камера на штативе; надпись «20 УРОКОВ БЕЗ КАМЕРЫ» без ошибок, других слов и логотипов нет
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16. The woman from the reference in her burgundy blouse sits at her desk in the bright home study, confident, a slight knowing smile, arms crossed; next to her a camera on a tripod is pushed aside and covered with a lens cap, a ring light switched off. She is on the RIGHT half of the frame, from the waist up. On the LEFT, large bold title in four lines: white «20», white «УРОКОВ», bright orange «БЕЗ», bright orange «КАМЕРЫ», over a softly blurred light wall with a dark semi-transparent band behind the text for contrast. All text must sit between 25% and 70% of the image height.
